name: Kayako
description: Kayako is a customer-service platform for conversations, shared inboxes, messaging, help centers, routing, automation, customer context, and support operations.
agentUseSummary: Enter one Kayako tenant and customer-owned OAuth access token, then let selected agents use content-free case operations or approved documented API v1 requests under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: KAYAKO_DOMAIN
credentialRequirements.label: Kayako domain
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the tenant hostname label before .kayako.com.

credentialRequirements.name: KAYAKO_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Kayako OAuth access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Supply a customer-owned OAuth token with conversations:read and only explicitly needed write scopes.

capabilities.label: Read case operations
capabilities.description: List and inspect bounded case operational metadata without subjects, requester/creator identities, posts, messages, channels, teams, agents, tags, forms, custom fields, ratings, or raw records.

capabilities.label: Kayako API v1
capabilities.description: Use documented tenant-bound API v1 paths and methods allowed by the token's scopes and user permissions.

approvalRequired.label: List case metadata
approvalRequired.description: List one fixed first page of content-free Kayako case summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read case metadata
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact Kayako case through Relay's content-free projection.

approvalRequired.label: Use Kayako API v1
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented Kayako API v1 operation authorized by the supplied OAuth token; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Content-free case reads and every broader API operation require approval; tenant/version binding, OAuth-token isolation, scope/user context, bounds, and limits remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected token-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; tenant/version binding, OAuth-token isolation, bounds, audits, scopes, user permissions, and Kayako limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted OAuth access token only to the tenant-bound Kayako API v1 origin.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted OAuth access token only to the tenant-bound Kayako API v1 origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Kayako tenant and customer-owned OAuth access token are required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Supply a customer-owned Kayako OAuth token with conversations:read and only explicitly needed write scopes, enter the tenant/token in Relay, and verify bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader operations, scope/user changes, rate limits, expiration, refresh/rotation, revocation, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Kayako documents tenant-local OAuth 2.0 Bearer access tokens, authorization-code and refresh-token grants, and conversations:read/write scopes enforced alongside user access.
Kayako documents case listing and exact retrieval at /api/v1/cases.json and /api/v1/cases/{id}.json, ordered by update time and protected by the conversations scope.
Kayako documents default offset-zero pagination, a default limit of ten, and explicit offset/limit controls.
Kayako documents per-minute action/resource rate limits and HTTP 429 responses carrying Retry-After.
